entries.title: I Corinthians 7:1
segments: Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:2
segments: But, because of fornications, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:3
segments: Let the husband render unto the wife her due: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:4
segments: The wife hath not power over her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power over his own body, but the wife.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:5
segments: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be by consent for a season, that ye may give yourselves unto prayer, and may be together again, that Satan tempt you not because of your incontinency.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:6
segments: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:7
segments: Yet I would that all men were even as I myself. Howbeit each man hath his own gift from God, one after this manner, and another after that.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:8
segments: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:9
segments: But if they have not continency, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:10
segments: But unto the married I give charge, [yea] not I, but the Lord, That the wife depart not from her husband

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:11
segments: (but should she depart, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband); and that the husband leave not his wife.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:12
segments: But to the rest say I, not the Lord: If any brother hath an unbelieving wife, and she is content to dwell with him, let him not leave her.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:13
segments: And the woman that hath an unbelieving husband, and he is content to dwell with her, let her not leave her husband.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:14
segments: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the brother: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:15
segments: Yet if the unbelieving departeth, let him depart: the brother or the sister is not under bondage in such [cases]: but God hath called us in peace.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:16
segments: For how knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? Or how knowest thou, O husband, whether thou shalt save thy wife?

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:17
segments: Only, as the Lord hath distributed to each man, as God hath called each, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all the churches.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:18
segments: Was any man called being circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Hath any been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:19
segments: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing; but the keeping of the commandments of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:20
segments: Let each man abide in that calling wherein he was called.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:21
segments: Wast thou called being a bondservant? Care not for it: nay, even if thou canst become free, use [it] rather.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:22
segments: For he that was called in the Lord being a bondservant, is the Lord's freedman: likewise he that was called being free, is Christ's bondservant.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:23
segments: Ye were bought with a price; become not bondservants of men.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:24
segments: Brethren, let each man, wherein he was called, therein abide with God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:25
segments: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: but I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be trustworthy.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:26
segments: I think therefore that this is good by reason of the distress that is upon us, [namely,] that it is good for a man to be as he is.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:27
segments: Art thou bound unto a wife? Seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? Seek not a wife.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:28
segments: But shouldest thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Yet such shall have tribulation in the flesh: and I would spare you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:29
segments: But this I say, brethren, the time is shortened, that henceforth both those that have wives may be as though they had none;

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:30
segments: and those that weep, as though they wept not; and those that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and those that buy, as though they possessed not;

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:31
segments: and those that use the world, as not using it to the full: for the fashion of this world passeth away.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:32
segments: But I would have you to be free from cares. He that is unmarried is careful for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord:

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:33
segments: but he that is married is careful for the things of the world, how he may please his wife,

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:34
segments: and is divided. [So] also the woman that is unmarried and the virgin is careful for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married is careful for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:35
segments: And this I say for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is seemly, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:36
segments: But if any man thinketh that he behaveth himself unseemly toward his virgin [daughter], if she be past the flower of her age, and if need so requireth, let him do what he will; he sinneth not; let them marry.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:37
segments: But he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power as touching in his own heart, to keep his own virgin [daughter], shall do well.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:38
segments: So then both he that giveth his own virgin [daughter] in marriage doeth well; and he that giveth her not in marriage shall do better.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:39
segments: A wife is bound for so long time as her husband liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is free to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 7:40
segments: But she is happier if she abide as she is, after my judgment: and I think that I also have the Spirit of God.
